description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are not managed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify systems and environments where identity lifecycle management processes are absent or inadequate, including lack of credential provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning procedures for users, services, and hardware devices.
